**Opened PR #891 for the #862 memory-lane ruling — record-first via memory:save, cold review launched**

**What**: PR #891 (Closes #862, Parent #864 task 1.1, type:docs) opened on 2026-09-09 from branch feat/issue-862-decisionmemory-memory-rides-the-features (worktree brain-issue-862), head 3fe0fde3. Five commits: ruling artifacts (9541aa92), ADR-0034 + three amendments (110fcaa6), tickets #886–#890 filed and written into the epic (2c4e0582), section-5 note (adfb0aac), session record rec-573fd33abe4d2335 via `memory:save --issue 862` plus one index line (3fe0fde3). Cold review running in background (scratchpad review-891.log).

**Why**: same shape as #875 for #863: a ruling PR under openspec/ only, drafts promoted later in a separate maintainer sitting.

**Where**: PR #891; openspec/changes/issue-862-memory-lane/**; openspec/changes/issue-864-memory-2-0/tasks.md.

**Learned**: `memory:save` shape is `npm run memory:save -- "<title>" "<content>" --type <t> --issue N`; restore .memory/index.jsonl to HEAD before saving so the committed index diff is exactly +1 line (hydration otherwise pollutes it). apply-progress.md stays untracked (#863 did not track it either). Pending after the verdict: task 5.3, file the promotion-sitting follow-up ticket for the four drafts (the #876 analogue).
